01 /About us

We know dance. We feel every detail.

RodiArt is an atelier in Athens specialising in made-to-measure ballroom dresses for the Latin programme. We create original dresses and costumes for children and adults. Our work draws on years of experience in ballroom dancing and creating dance dresses.

Each look is designed for the individual dancer, taking their personality, figure and movement into account. Together, we discuss the idea, develop a sketch and choose fabrics and embellishments, so the dress expresses individuality and allows freedom of movement. We can discuss your ideas and order details in Russian, Ukrainian, English and Greek.

03 /From idea to dress

First, your dream.
Then, the magic of the atelier.

Every dress begins with a conversation. Together with an experienced designer, we turn your wishes into a look you cannot wait to bring to life on the dance floor.

  1. We listen and find inspiration

    We discuss your wishes, the character of your dance and the mood of your future look.

  2. We consider every line

    Together with the designer, we develop the silhouette and choose fabrics, colours and embellishments.

  3. We visualise your dream

    We bring the ideas together in a sketch, discuss the details and imagine the dress in motion with you.

04 /

From the first stitch to the final rhinestone.

Feathers, fringe and shimmering embellishments — every detail becomes part of your movement. We create an original dress just for you, bringing every element of your look together for an expressive presence on the dance floor.

04 /Latin dresses & costumes

Latin dance dresses made to measure

An original, individually designed dress is an essential part of your presence on the dance floor. It becomes an extension of your personality and movement, bringing out the character of your dancing and giving you the freedom to stand out and shine.

01

Women's Latin dresses

Colour, silhouette and embellishment create your signature on the dance floor. We design your dress around the look you want to express through your dancing.

02

Latin competition costumes

The energy of a movement, the line of the body, the rhythm — a competition costume helps bring them into focus. A considered fit lets you concentrate on your dancing.

03

Children's Latin dresses

A distinctive look for a young dancer, designed with her age and comfort in mind, so she can enjoy every step on the dance floor.
